AntiPattern.Bad: `export let userId: string; export let onConfirm: () => void;` at the top of a ``.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Svelte 4 prop syntax. Forbidden by `AX_LEGACY_PATTERNS_FORBIDDEN` and `AX_PROPS_VIA_DESTRUCTURING`. Bypasses the single `$props()` destructure that is the only authoritative props surface in Svelte 5; mixing it with `$props()` in the same component is undefined behaviour.
AntiPattern.Good: `let { userId, onConfirm } = $props();` — single destructure at the top of the script, defaults inline if needed.
